lines.text: Some mornings the weight is already there before you open your eyes.
You tell yourself tomorrow will be lighter.
Faith is not pretending the road isn't long.
It's taking the next step anyway.
Something small is still growing in you.
You are held by something steadier than how you feel today.
Let that be enough for this morning.

title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Steady, even when the day isn't.
